scope.intended_use: Stable product-capability discovery and risk-aware planning by an operator or automation client before consulting a target instance contract.

records.name: Web API and access tokens

scope.organization_behavior: The token inherits the owner identity's effective roles and organization reach; the public guide does not grant cross-organization access.

reasons: A token can exercise every operation its owner may perform

risk.blast_radius: From one readable object to system-wide or fleet-wide effects, depending on the selected operation and identity.

effects: Create, change, delete, assign, publish, synchronize, or command resources when the target contract permits
external_effects: May affect managed devices, users, integrations, and external services
destructive_effects: Depends on the resolved operation and can include irreversible device or data actions
concurrency_cautions: Do not retry mutations unless target-contract idempotency is proven
Honor target revision or ETag controls

preconditions: Match target origin, reported version, organization, identity, contract digest, and operation
read_back: Use a direct target-contract read operation after mutation
audit: Match actor, method, endpoint, organization, status, and time
functional_checks: Run only the smallest separately authorized canary behavior check

requirements: Resolve rollback from the same target contract
Capture prior state before mutation
limitations: Some device actions, imports, migrations, and deletions are not faithfully reversible

contract_checks: Resolve effective server and security scheme
Confirm token header name from the target contract or official target UI
Inspect every referenced request and response schema

evidence.claim: The official guide documents Relution REST API access, user access tokens, representative operations, and background import jobs.
